name: Marigold Kameez & Izhar
description: A long kameez in warm marigold — hand-embroidered with zardozi and resham, paired with izhar and a heavily worked dupatta. Traditional in silhouette, considered in craft. Made for the moments that matter.
fabricNotes: Hand-work zardozi and resham embroidery across the kameez, izhar pants and dupatta.
